scope: Loss input validation and standalone logits arithmetic; no model construction, training examples, or optimizer calls. Not the full frozen 40-case model correctness gate.
deselection_reason: Two full-model resume tests require locked initialization; three CUDA tests are outside local MLX/CPU scope.
command: PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_restart_loss_inputs.py tests/test_loss_stability.py -k 'not resumes and not cuda'
regressions_fixed: Infinite supervision weights and overflowed mask sums rejected before forward.
Nonfinite logits, malformed shapes, noninteger targets and out-of-range targets rejected explicitly.
numerical_evidence: Winning logits from -60 to 60: analytic losses and every gradient checked, including tiny nonzero tails.
Representable common-offset invariance and FP64 multiclass reference checks pass.
Masked real-backend loss and gradients match native FP64 within absolute 1e-6; padding gradient is zero while EOS gradients remain nonzero.
runtime_limitation: Finite/input checks synchronize backend values; throughput impact remains unmeasured and must be included in future M1 feasibility measurements.
